entries.sourceGenerationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Diablo 3D candidate modeling turnaround, NOT a finished runtime icon.
Input image 1: PRIVATE original pixel-art silhouette and color reference for ONE item, Two-Handed Sword, item.design.base.two-handed-sword, ICURS_TWO_HANDED_SWORD 110. Use it only to inform a wholly NEW detailed concept; never paste its pixels or reproduce a pixel-art inset. Input image 2: layout, neutral rendering and presentation style reference ONLY (the clean Claymore board); do not copy its sword design.
Create a clean high-detail realistic game-prop concept sheet with the exact SAME SINGLE physical object shown whole in FRONT flat face, true SIDE thickness, BACK opposite face, and THREE-QUARTER views, plus a smaller NEW HD rendered inventory-composition thumbnail of that same concept. Large clearly separated vertical views; charcoal-gray background, neutral soft studio illumination, restrained fine wear. Labels only TWO-HANDED SWORD / FRONT / SIDE / BACK / 3-4 / ICON, understated light serif lettering. Keep all tips and pommels inside the frame.
Identity is the unusual reference, NOT a generic two-handed steel sword: long nearly straight tapered upper body, sharp exposed dark-silver steel point; most of its length is warm opaque burnt-orange/ochre-brown, interrupted by broad diagonal pale silver-gray bands around the body. Preserve the original relative proportions, orange dominance, alternating bands and silhouette. Near the lower blade/base retain the conspicuous dark oval pierced space with pale metal rim and branching curled silver-gray guard, then a long dark reddish-brown grip and small muted brass/olive-gold pommel. The original band's exact construction and the orange material are ambiguous: for THIS CANDIDATE ONLY infer a solid copper-toned orange-brown inset or facing restrained by diagonal pale steel bands, with real non-emissive material. Do not claim this material is recovered historical fact. The BACK and thickness are proposed reconstructions; keep the bands count/positions, guard topology, grip length, pommel and point coherent across every view, including the small thumbnail. The SIDE view must show thin physical thickness and the guard's actual profile, not a second full face. BACK is the opposite face of the same geometry.
No fire, glow, magic particles, neon, broad generic claymore blade, extra jewels, skulls, hands, characters, scenery, measurements, collage, source pixel-art or alternate designs. No giant shadow or colored rim light. Every object depiction including ICON is freshly rendered in the same clean realistic HD material style.
